metadata.description: Supermetrics for Claude: marketing data from 150+ platforms plus ready-made analytics workflows.

plugins.name: supermetrics-marketing
plugins.description: Connect Claude to your marketing data with Supermetrics — Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Ads, Shopify, HubSpot and 150+ more sources — then analyze it with 42 ready-made workflows: week-over-week performance, wasted spend, ad fatigue, budget pacing, ROAS, funnel reconciliation and executive summaries. Includes the Supermetrics connector; sign in once with OAuth. Read-only: never changes your ad accounts.
